facts.statement: The study aimed to create a delivery system that holds stem cell-derived vesicles in a gel to help repair brain tissue after injury.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Vesicles were taken from stem cells grown in a 3D structure and placed into a gelatin-based gel.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The gel was injected into the injured area of the brain, and researchers checked for recovery using behavior tests, cell staining, and gene analysis.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: In living animals, the gel stayed in the brain longer, caused less tissue damage, and improved movement and memory over time.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The treatment led to more dividing cells that showed signs of becoming nerve cells or their support cells in specific brain areas.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The treatment raised levels of a specific protein in stem cells, which triggered a chain of gene changes that supported the growth of new nerve cells.
